result.title: Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence
result.summary: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CT-RuleBank.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个 agent 系统，为每个报告模型学习可执行的规则库（rule bank），在推理时依据独立分类器预测与定量图像测量对 3D 胸 CT 报告做局部修订，且每处修改都可追溯到触发规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 规则库实质是「外部视觉证据何时、如何改写生成结果」的可学习策略，与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、证据贡献分配及修订/停止判断可供核查；但其作用于离散文本编辑而非内部 latent 状态，迁移性需进一步核实。
